title: Rename Window-Scoped Tool System To Utility
description:
Rename the entire window-scoped interactive "tool" object model to "utility" everywhere, so the word "tool" is freed up for a different upcoming concept. Full rename, not a compat shim — types, fields, functions, doc comments, and the ui-kit's generic rendering components.

Rust (framework/core/rs/lib.rs): ToolDefinition -> UtilityDefinition, ToolCategory -> UtilityCategory, ToolRef -> UtilityRef, ToolCategory import re-export from ui_wgpu, WindowKindDefinition.tools -> .utilities, AppDefinition.tools -> .utilities, SetActiveTool action variant -> SetActiveUtility (window_kind_id/tool_id field -> utility_id), related doc comments/tests.

ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs: pub mod tools -> pub mod utilities (or equivalent), ToolCategory enum -> UtilityCategory, ToolNode enum -> UtilityNode (Button/Separator/Collection variants unchanged), any tool_id fields -> utility_id.

framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs (AppBuilder/PluginBundle): .tool()/.tool_simple() builder methods -> .utility()/.utility_simple(), doc comments referencing "Scopes tools to a window kind/mode".

Every plugin crate that registers window tools via .tool(...)/.tool_simple(...)/ToolDefinition/ToolCategory: note, puzzle (2d/3d), lowpoly, cad, remodel, raster, draw, procedural, shooting, s, trinity, forms, imperative, and any others found via grep. Update local helper functions like note_tool/puzzle2d_tool/lowpoly_tool/raster_tool/draw_tool/cad_transform_tool -> the *_utility naming, and their call sites' tool ids/labels stay the same (only the Rust identifiers/types rename).

framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx: activeToolByWindowId -> activeUtilityByWindowId, SET_ACTIVE_TOOL action type/dispatch -> SET_ACTIVE_UTILITY, the "🧰WindowToolRegistry" region -> "🧰WindowUtilityRegistry", resolveWindowTools -> resolveWindowUtilities, resolveWindowToolNodes -> resolveWindowUtilityNodes, tagSetActiveToolWindow -> tagSetActiveUtilityWindow, windowToolbarNode stays conceptually the toolbar rendering function but should be renamed consistently (e.g. windowUtilityBarNode) since it composes UtilityNode trees, WINDOW_TOOL_CATEGORIES -> WINDOW_UTILITY_CATEGORIES, injectActiveTool -> injectActiveUtility, SET_ACTIVE_TOOL_ACTION_ID -> SET_ACTIVE_UTILITY_ACTION_ID, all related types/imports from ui_wgpu (ToolNode, ToolCategory) and framework/core (ToolDefinition, ToolRef).

ui/js/react/index.tsx (ui-kit): ToolTree component -> UtilityTree, groupToolNodesByCategory -> groupUtilityNodesByCategory, deriveToolNodes -> deriveUtilityNodes, toolDefinitionToSpec -> utilityDefinitionToSpec, and any other Tool-prefixed exports/types feeding this same window-tool data model. Update .storybook/stories/ui/Toolbar.stories.tsx to match (rename story/component references consistently; keep the file itself since project rules forbid new test/example files, so edit in place — do not create a new stories file).

Also update the WIT/plugin ABI and TS bridge if they reference these Rust type names directly (grep framework/plugin/host and any .wit files), and regenerate any generated TS bindings if there's an existing generate script (do not hand-edit gitignored generated files if a generator exists — run it).

Do NOT rename: the generic "toolbar" CSS class names / data-slot attributes if they are purely presentational DOM hooks unrelated to the Tool type names (use judgement — only rename identifiers that denote this specific tool/utility object model, not every English use of the word "tool"). Do NOT touch unrelated "tool" usages like MCP tools, dev tooling, CLI tools, or generic prose in comments about developer tooling.

This is a mechanical, codebase-wide identifier rename with no behavior change. Must compile/typecheck clean afterward (cargo check --tests across touched crates; ui-react and framework-renderer-react typecheck/vitest). Extend existing test files only; do not create new ones. Add code via existing regions/subregions.
summary:
Renamed the entire window-scoped interactive "tool" object model to "utility" across Rust and TypeScript, freeing the plain word "tool" for an unrelated future concept. Mechanical rename, no behavior change (wire-format action id/JSON keys changed in lockstep on both Rust and TS sides where they were part of this model, e.g. `setActiveTool`→`setActiveUtility`, `toolId`→`utilityId`).

Rename map applied:
- Types: `ToolDefinition`→`UtilityDefinition`, `ToolCategory`→`UtilityCategory` (variants Selection/Tools/History/Sync kept as-is — the `Tools` category member itself is untouched, only the enum type name changed), `ToolRef`→`UtilityRef`, `ToolNode`→`UtilityNode` (Button/Separator/Collection variants kept as-is), `DerivedToolSpec`→`DerivedUtilitySpec`.
- Rust builder API (`framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs` AppBuilder): `.tool()`→`.utility()`, `.tool_simple()`→`.utility_simple()`, `window_kind_tools()`→`window_kind_utilities()`, `mode_tools()`→`mode_utilities()`.
- Fields: `WindowKindDefinition.tools`/`AppDefinition.tools`/`ModeDefinition.tools`→`.utilities` (and every plugin's struct-literal call site); `ViewState.active_tool_id`→`.active_utility_id`; `WindowMeasure::Group.active_tool_id`→`.active_utility_id` (including its ts-rs `rename = "activeToolId"` attribute, which was overriding the derived camelCase name and had to be fixed separately from the field rename); `RefreshRequest`/`RefreshResponse.tools`→`.utilities` (the toolbar partial-refresh wire section).
- Actions: `HostEffect::SetActiveTool`→`SetActiveUtility` (Rust enum variant + TS mirror + `"setActiveTool"`→`"setActiveUtility"` wire string + `effect.setActiveTool`/`"setActiveTool" in effect}` call sites), `SET_ACTIVE_TOOL_ACTION_ID`→`SET_ACTIVE_UTILITY_ACTION_ID` (value `"setActiveTool"`→`"setActiveUtility"`), `set_active_tool_action_definition()`→`set_active_utility_action_definition()`, label `"Set Active Tool"`→`"Set Active Utility"`, arg `"toolId"`→`"utilityId"` with label `"Tool"`→`"Utility"`.
- `IntroductionAnchor::Tool`/`IntroductionAdvance::Tool` enum variants (wrap a `UtilityRef`) → `::Utility` — missed on the first pass, found via a stale `"kind":"tool"` mismatch surfaced by `ui-react` typecheck; fixed in Rust plus the three TS call sites matching on `"tool"` (`ui/js/react/index.tsx` `introductionAnchorSelector`/advance-hint text/test, `framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx` introduction-advance check).
- TS/React (`framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx`): `activeToolByWindowId`→`activeUtilityByWindowId`, `activeToolId`→`activeUtilityId`, `resolveWindowTools`→`resolveWindowUtilities`, `resolveWindowToolNodes`→`resolveWindowUtilityNodes`, `tagSetActiveToolWindow`→`tagSetActiveUtilityWindow`, `windowToolbarNode`→`windowUtilityBarNode`, `WINDOW_TOOL_CATEGORIES`→`WINDOW_UTILITY_CATEGORIES`, `injectActiveTool`→`injectActiveUtility`, `ToolTree`/`ToolTreeProps`→`UtilityTree`/`UtilityTreeProps` (prop `tools`→`utilities`), `groupToolNodesByCategory`→`groupUtilityNodesByCategory`, `toolDefinitionToSpec`→`utilityDefinitionToSpec`, `ToolLeaf`/`ToolCollectionNode`→`UtilityLeaf`/`UtilityCollectionNode`, `sortToolNodes`/`dedupeToolNodesById`/`isInteractiveToolNode`/`hasInteractiveToolNodes`/`hasInteractiveToolLeaves`/`toolNodeCategory`/`reconcileToolPath`/`frameworkHistoryToolNodes`/`resolveToolActivation`→`*Utility*` equivalents, `TOOL_CATEGORY_ORDER`/`TOOL_CATEGORY_ICON_ID`→`UTILITY_*`, `//#region 🧰WindowToolRegistry`→`WindowUtilityRegistry`, `//#region 🗂️ToolCategoryGrouping`→`UtilityCategoryGrouping`. `ToolTree`/`groupToolNodesByCategory`/`deriveToolNodes` actually live in `os-shell.tsx` and `framework/core/js/index.ts`, not `ui/js/react/index.tsx` as the ticket draft assumed — confirmed by grep and renamed at their real location instead.
- `framework/product/os/core/js/index.ts`: `FrameworkSyncToolLeaf`→`FrameworkSyncUtilityLeaf`, `buildFrameworkSyncTools`→`buildFrameworkSyncUtilities`.
- Rust plugin helper fns: `note_tool`→`note_utility`, `puzzle2d_tool`/`puzzle2d_active_tool`→`puzzle2d_utility`/`puzzle2d_active_utility`, `lowpoly_tool`→`lowpoly_utility`, `raster_tool`→`raster_utility`, `draw_tool`→`draw_utility`, `cad_transform_tool`/`cad_transform_tool_refs`→`cad_transform_utility`/`cad_transform_utility_refs`, `process3d_active_tool`→`process3d_active_utility`, `view_with_tool`→`view_with_utility`, plus renderer-side `derive_tool_nodes`→`derive_utility_nodes`, `tool_toggle_node`→`utility_toggle_node`, `resolve_window_tools`→`resolve_window_utilities`, `partition_tools_by_category`→`partition_utilities_by_category`, `apply_set_active_tool`→`apply_set_active_utility`, `active_tools` field→`active_utilities`, `framework_sync_tools`→`framework_sync_utilities`, `tool_button`/`tool_toggle`/`tool_separator`/`tool_collection`→`utility_*`, `tool_registry_declares_tools[_scoped_to_...]`→`utility_registry_declares_utilities[_scoped_to_...]`, `overview_tools`→`overview_utilities`.
- `ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs`: `pub mod tools`→`pub mod utilities` (doc comment updated too), re-export list at crate root updated.
- `framework/wit/world.wit`: doc-comment prose updated (`window/panel/tools/...`→`.../utilities/...`).

Verification: `cargo check --tests` passed clean (0 errors) for every touched Rust crate — framework-core (`semio-framework-core`), framework-plugin (`semio-framework-plugin`), framework-plugin-host (`semio-framework-plugin-host`), ui_wgpu, framework-renderer-wgpu (`semio-framework-renderer-wgpu`), framework-product-os-core (`semio-framework-os`), and plugins cad-plugin, lowpoly-plugin, note-plugin, puzzle-plugin, raster-plugin, remodel-plugin, remodel_document, process-plugin, gis-plugin. draw-plugin/procedural-plugin/shooting-plugin/s-plugin fail to compile, but on unrelated pre-existing/concurrent errors (`missing field 'loading' in initializer of UiTreeItemNode/UiTreeSectionNode/UiTreeNode`, and in s-plugin an unrelated `cannot find module semio_framework_core` typo) — confirmed via `git diff` that none of my edits touch `loading` or that import, so these are another in-flight refactor, not caused by this rename. Ran `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-core:generate` twice (once after the Rust rename, again after the `IntroductionAnchor`/`ts(rename=...)` fix) so the gitignored `framework/core/js/generated/manifest.ts` mirrors the renamed Rust types. `ui-react` typecheck and `framework-renderer-react` vitest (160/160 passing) show zero Tool/Utility-related errors; the `ui-react` vitest run has 14 pre-existing failures (CanvasPickMenu pointerdown, ShellDisplayPanel/ShellSettingsPanel/ShellSearchDialog/ShellFindDialog "renders without crashing", tree-helpers rendering) all unrelated to this rename — none reference tool/utility identifiers and none are in code this ticket touched. `framework-renderer-react` lint also flags one unrelated pre-existing issue (`components/world-terrain-layer.tsx` missing a Host export) in a file this ticket never touched; the region-balance check passed, confirming the renamed `//#region`/`//#endregion` markers in `os-shell.tsx` stayed matched.

Deliberately left unchanged (reviewed, judged out of scope):
- `ToolCategory::Tools`/`UtilityCategory::Tools` enum member and its serialized/string-literal value `"tools"` everywhere it appears as a category value (not the type name) — kept, matching the instruction to leave ToolNode's own variant names alone.
- The internal `ToolbarRibbonSegment` `"tools"` segment-kind tag (`os-shell.tsx`) — a private, non-wire-format discriminant that coincidentally shares the word with the category value; left alone to avoid unrequested scope creep.
- `.storybook/stories/ui/Toolbar.stories.tsx` — reviewed; only references the generic `ToolbarZone/Group/Item/Divider` components and its own self-contained demo code, no `Tool*` model types imported, so nothing needed changing.
- `framework/renderer/react/components/{raster-host,canvas-2d-host,note-canvas-host,world-3d-host,puzzle-2d-board-host}.tsx`, `.storybook/puzzle-2d.spec.ts`, `.storybook/stories/puzzle/2d/Board.stories.tsx`, `raster/rs/lib.rs`, `puzzle/2d/rs/lib.rs`, `note/rs/lib.rs`, `infinite/board/**/rs/lib.rs`, and the matching `RasterScene`/`Puzzle2dBoardScene`/`NoteCanvasScene.activeTool` TS mirror types in `framework/core/js/index.ts` — these all use their own independent, per-plugin WASM-host `active_tool`/`activeTool` (no "Id" suffix) scene-state field, unrelated to `ViewState.active_utility_id`/`UtilityNode`; confirmed by reading each definition before excluding.
- `trinity/plugin/rs/lib.rs`, `writer/plugin/rs/lib.rs`, `sequence/plugin/rs/lib.rs` — call a `app.tools(&view_state)` method that no longer exists on `DocumentApp`/`PluginApp` (a separate, already-broken/mid-refactor feature per an existing in-code comment); not part of this model, left untouched.
- `kernel/3d/brep/rs/lib.rs` `tool_ids`/boolean-op "tool solids", `.mcp`/CLI/dev-tooling comments, and thousands of unrelated prose "tool(s)" mentions — left untouched.

Also fixed one bug found only by re-running `cargo check` after the rename: `framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs` constructs `ModeDefinition`/`WindowKindDefinition`/`AppDefinition` literals with `tools: Vec::new()` in ~19 places — updated to `utilities: Vec::new()` (this crate wasn't in the ticket's example plugin list but is a real consumer of the renamed fields).
